**Finding submitted: deviation on § 12.4 (p0045).**

- **Only responsive clause:** § 12.4 (p0045) is the sole non-solicit in the document; searches for "solicit", "recruit/induce/no-hire/non-solicitation", and "employ or engage" surfaced nothing else. § 12.3 (p0044) is the countervailing Customer-freedom clause, and the second § 12.4 (sec-12.4-2) is a non-compete belonging to a different rule, so I did not flag it here.
- **Why it fails fallback:** one-sided (not mutual), all Vendor employees (not personnel involved in the Services), term + 24 months (not 12 months post-involvement), express no-hire ("hire, or employ"), and "regardless of how the employee applies" affirmatively negates both the general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs — walk-away territory, and it contradicts Vendor's acknowledgement in § 12.3 that Customer gave no no-hire commitment.
- **Cure:** targeted the preferred level with the shortest edit that the minimality gate accepted (whole-paragraph deletion was rejected), replacing only the restrictive words with confirmation that Customer is subject to no such restriction; no cross-references to Section 12.4 exist, so nothing dangles. Fallback terms are offered in the comment.
